## Introduction: The Company of Strangers!

[How many strangers do you "meet" everyday? Why is the Human Species
different from all others?]{style="background-color:yellow;"} Those two questions are not unrelated !! The Human Species is perhaps unique in that we are able to [cooperate
with strangers](https://fee.org/articles/book-reviews-september-2004/) 

![](https://pup-assets.imgix.net/onix/images/9780691146461.jpg?w=410&auto=format){height="250px" fig-align="center"}

Yes! Do you think that designing things, building and conducting a business, or making art is something like that? No? Well, let us see a few quick stories!!

This is the story of a young man who leaves home from Tarbes, in
Gascony, France, to travel to Paris to make his fortune. He has two
blessings,one each from his mother and his father. True to the
instructions given by his Dad, and his very Gascon nature, [he picks
a fight even before he reaches Paris.](https://youtu.be/KXvzAvOL5GI)

### Discussion-1

-   Why are they TALKING, when they have come to fight?? ["When have to shoot, shoot! Don't talk!"](https://youtu.be/JrYtD7gSWsI?feature=shared) said
    [Eli Wallach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eli_Wallach).
-   Pardon,m'sieu, but why were they so polite to each other? (Oh, These
    French...)
-   Were they talking as if they didn't want to fight?
-   But to "have fought already"?
-   The **Shadow of the Future**

### Discussion-2

What **emotions** or **motivations** are portrayed by the characters in
the story? We can think of the "4Rs":

-   Reward
-   Regret aka FOMO
-   Risk
-   Retribution/Punishment

## <u>[Wait, But Why?](https://waitbutwhy.com)</u>

-   Many public behaviours require us to *trust* strangers
-   We have Rule of Law based on this trust
-   If there is no **C** at first, then everybody does a **D**
-   That is the source of the **Dilemma**
-   As Artists and Designers, and Creators, we need to practice our
    craft that in such a way as to induce *niceness*...
-   So what will you make? A movie? An ad? A public sign-board? A street
    play? An illustration? A "spatial arrangement"? A policy or a law?

## Activity-1

Take your favourite show/episode, film, or short story and look at the
conduct of the characters. Decide whether these were C or D, and why!

Make a Poster and put it up. Show and Tell in 1 hour!
